definition: An acronym for intellectual developmental disorder with dysmorphic facies and behavioral abnormalities (OMIM #618089), a rare autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental syndrome caused by pathogenic variants (primarily de novo) in the FBXO11 gene. It typically manifests in the first years of life with highly variable features that include borderline-to-severe intellectual disability, behavioral difficulties, facial dysmorphisms, hypotonia, minor skeletal abnormalities, ocular anomalies, and recurrent infections.

source.title: New ocular findings in a patient with a novel pathogenic variant in the FBXO11 gene
source.quote: Intellectual developmental disorder with dysmorphic facies and behavioral abnormalities (IDDFBA) is a recently described autosomal dominant entity caused by pathogenic variants, mostly de novo, in the FBXO11 gene. It presents in the first years of life with highly variable clinical manifestations. The main features of IDDFBA include borderline-to-severe intellectual disability, behavioral problems, hypotonia, facial dysmorphisms, minor skeletal abnormalities, and recurrent infections.
